issues.detail: Hebrew 'שֹׂנְאוֹתַיִךְ' means 'those who hate you' (active participle, feminine plural, with 2fs suffix), but Vietnamese renders it as 'những kẻ ngươi ghét' ('those you hate'), reversing the subject-object relationship. The correct meaning is 'those who hate you' (your haters), not 'those whom you hate'.
